Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when the answer is a replay of the stored answer of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

ETag.description: A weak validator of the aggregate version, e.g. `W/"3"`.

dwellThresholdMinutes.description: Per trailer kind (DRY_VAN, REEFER, FLATBED, CONTAINER); a kind without an entry is never alerted.

declared.description: False while the answer is the default policy of an undeclared site.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, a NUL byte, a missing or invalid Idempotency-Key, or an invalid path or query parameter.
